tickets.title: Update household profile and address records for shared residence
tickets.text: Update the household profile and address records to reflect Mira Willowdoodle’s move into Arlen Copperwisp’s Lakewood townhouse while preserving separate ownership notes for Mira’s premarital accounts.
tickets.evidence: After moving into Arlen’s townhouse, Mira asked that advisory records reflect the shared household while preserving her preferred separate ownership notes for premarital accounts; the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-06 is to update the household profile and address records.

tickets.title: Obtain and file marriage certificate evidence
tickets.text: Obtain a certified or scanned copy of the marriage certificate for Mira and Arlen to provide to the custodian and insurance carriers for account registration, beneficiary, and name-related records.
tickets.evidence: The custodian and insurance carriers may require a certified or scanned marriage certificate for account registration, beneficiary, and name-related records, and Mossy Meteor Advisory did not have a copy in the client file;

tickets.title: Provide taxable account registration options
tickets.text: Provide a plain-language comparison of keeping Mira’s Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account individually titled versus opening a new joint account for future household savings.
tickets.evidence: Mira asked for paperwork and a plain-language comparison for keeping her Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account individually titled versus opening a new joint account for future household savings; the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-01 is to provide the taxable account registration options.

tickets.title: Address online access and view-only permissions for spouse
tickets.text: Address Arlen’s request for view-only access to the household dashboard without granting trading authority over Mira’s individual IRA and taxable accounts.
tickets.evidence: She also asked whether Arlen could receive view-only access to the household dashboard without giving him trading authority over her individual IRA and taxable accounts; the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-29 is to address online access for a spouse and household view.

tickets.title: Resolve beneficiary record inconsistencies across accounts
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistent beneficiary records: update Mira’s IRA records to reflect post-marriage designations and address the missing primary beneficiary on Arlen’s employer plan. Confirm the correct designations across all accounts.
tickets.evidence: The beneficiary information visible during the call showed Mira’s IRA records still naming Tobin Willowdoodle and Iris Willowdoodle, while Arlen’s employer-plan screen did not display a primary beneficiary, creating inconsistent post-marriage records across accounts; follow-up is needed by 2024-03-0

tickets.title: Address custodian beneficiary update error for Arlen as contingent beneficiary
tickets.text: Resolve the Velvet Acorn Custody website error when attempting to add Arlen Copperwisp as a contingent beneficiary to Mira’s accounts. Obtain a successful confirmation for the beneficiary update.
tickets.evidence: Mira reported that Velvet Acorn Custody’s website returned an error when she tried to add Arlen as a contingent beneficiary, and the failed session did not produce a confirmation number; the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-27 is to address the custodian beneficiary update error.

tickets.title: Review employer benefit elections for newlyweds
tickets.text: Review employer benefit elections for Mira and Arlen, including Clockwork Clover Robotics newlywed enrollment and Paper Otter Preparatory benefit-change processes, to address medical, life, and disability coverage choices for the combined household.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s Clockwork Clover Robotics newlywed enrollment window and Arlen’s Paper Otter Preparatory benefit-change process affect medical, life, and disability coverage choices for the combined household; the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-05 is to review employer benefit elections.

tickets.title: Align life and disability coverage across accounts
tickets.text: Align the beneficiary records and replacement-income assumptions across Mira’s individual term policy, group life coverage, Arlen’s term policy, and employer coverage to reflect the new household structure.
tickets.evidence: The review found that Mira’s individual term policy, Mira’s group life coverage, Arlen’s term policy, and Arlen’s employer coverage had different beneficiary records and replacement-income assumptions for the new household; follow-up is needed by 2024-03-14 on life and disability coverage alignment.

tickets.title: Collect estate document copies and amendment pages
tickets.text: Collect copies of the signed wills and financial powers of attorney for Mira and Arlen, including any amendment pages, to update the advisory planning record.
tickets.evidence: Mira and Arlen described older wills and powers of attorney, but Mossy Meteor Advisory did not have copies of the signed documents or any amendment pages in its planning record;

tickets.title: Review mortgage and property records
tickets.text: Obtain and review the current mortgage statement, deed vesting page, and homeowner policy declarations for Arlen’s Lakewood townhouse to update the advisory file with complete property records.
tickets.evidence: Arlen had the mortgage balance and rate available during the call, but the current mortgage statement, deed vesting page, and homeowner policy declarations were not available.

tickets.title: Prepare coordinated 2024 withholding and estimated-tax projection
tickets.text: Prepare a joint 2024 withholding and estimated-tax projection for Mira and Arlen to share with Celia Fablethimble of Apricot Compass Tax, accounting for two salaries, bonuses, investment income, and Mira’s $42,000 capital loss carryforward from 2022.
tickets.evidence: Mira and Arlen asked for a coordinated 2024 withholding and estimated-tax projection to share with Celia because the marriage combines two salaries, bonuses, investment income, and Mira’s capital loss carryforward; the agreed follow-up by 2024-04-05 is to prepare the joint tax withholding projection
